facts.rationale: Corrects the erroneous spawn-to-state-0 claim and avoids assigning an unproven entry event to state 4.
facts.value: Hammer routines pass motion-state indices to Item_80268E5C to select the table's callback tuple. Spawn initializes xD4C to 1 and selects state 1; resting setup selects 0; pickup selects 2; the shared held animation callback requests 3 when xD4C equals zero; Dropped selects 1 with mask 6; EnteredAir selects 5. State 4 has a table entry, but no local entry routine selects it.

facts.rationale: Retains the demonstrated source type and shape while removing unsupported compiled-size claims.
facts.value: Source-declared non-const ItemStateTable array with six entries. Each initializer supplies a motion/animation identifier followed by animation, physics and collision callbacks. States 2 and 3 have null physics and collision slots. Compiled byte extent and section placement are not established by this source declaration alone.

facts.rationale: Removes the unsupported carrier-lifecycle interpretation while retaining the demonstrated item behavior.
facts.value: Handles the Hammer item's EnteredAir event by selecting item state 5 and preserving headless model presentation when xD4C is nonpositive. State 5 delegates terrain handling to callbacks for resting state 0 and ordinary falling state 1. The local implementation does not establish that this event represents the fighter carrier jumping or entering an airborne action.

facts.rationale: The local helper performs head visibility maintenance, not countdown processing.
facts.value: Receives the Hammer HSD_GObj, extracts its Item payload, requests state 2 with ITEM_ANIM_UPDATE, and installs it_80293D94 in Item.entered_hitlag. It then passes the object to the local visibility helper, which tests xD4C and hides joint 3 when nonpositive without decrementing any countdown, and finally calls it_802725D4 with the same object.

facts.rationale: Corrects the explicit claim that the helper cannot accelerate beyond the configured magnitude.
facts.value: Extracts the Hammer Item, reads ItemAttr.x10_fall_speed and x14_fall_speed_max, and passes them with the object to it_80272860. The helper compares the signs of current vertical velocity and acceleration; when they differ, subtraction occurs only if the current velocity magnitude is below the supplied threshold, while matching signs permit subtraction directly. It subtracts acceleration from x40_vel.y without clamping the result, so an update may overshoot the threshold and existing excessive falling speed is not clamped.

evidence.why: Chance test and unchecked range computation.

facts.rationale: Preserves the cross-file timer purpose without claiming unchecked attributes guarantee a positive return.
facts.value: Generates the fighter-side Hammer head-loss countdown: it returns zero when the attribute-percentage chance test fails, otherwise returns HSD_Randi(x4 - x0) + x0 from the Hammer special attributes. With valid positive ordered timer bounds, the successful result is an active detachment delay; the routine itself does not validate those bounds or guarantee a positive result. The fighter stores the result in x2330.y and invokes head detachment when its guarded nonzero countdown reaches zero.

evidence.why: Visibility guard, decrement, constructor call and initialization.
Nullable constructor allocation and void return.

facts.rationale: Adds the supported allocation-failure branch and preserves numeric behavior beyond the normal one-shot initialization.
facts.value: When xD4C is positive, decrements it once and attempts separate Hammer Head creation using joint-derived launch inputs. Normal spawn initializes xD4C to 1, so the first qualifying invocation consumes that marker and later invocations skip creation. The constructor may fail allocation; its void return provides no success result and the Hammer does not restore xD4C. After either branch, joint 3 is hidden whenever xD4C is nonpositive. For an atypical value greater than 1, one invocation decrements and attempts creation without yet hiding the original head. The normal caller is fighter-side head-loss countdown expiration.

facts.rationale: Corrects the false restriction to state-1 intact-head callers.
facts.value: Once invoked, clears velocity, calls shared setup, selects state 0 with ITEM_ANIM_UPDATE, and applies the nonpositive-xD4C head-hiding helper. There is no local entry guard. State-1 collision supplies this callback only when xD4C is nonzero, but state-5 collision also supplies it without an xD4C guard; its supported-floor helper decides when to invoke it. State 0 has inert animation and physics callbacks and a separate collision path back to state 1 on support loss.

evidence.why: Table, head-count guards and local entry selectors.

facts.rationale: Corrects dropped-state numbering and distinguishes item head presence from the cross-file countdown.
facts.value: The Hammer table has resting state 0, ordinary falling state 1, held states 2 and 3, a state-4 gravity/contact callback tuple with no local entry selector, and EnteredAir state 5. Spawn and Dropped both select state 1, not states 0 and 4 respectively. Item.xD4C starts at 1, is decremented by head-detachment attempts, controls visibility with a nonpositive test, and triggers held-state-3 requests only at exactly zero. The random head-loss countdown is separately stored and advanced in fighter code.
